book: Nancy Caroline · Chapter 8 · Vascular Access and Medication Administration
title: Giving Medications: Routes, Doses, Drip Rates

slides.title: Today's lesson
slides.body:
As an EMR you already give ASA, nitroglycerin, salbutamol and oral glucose, and epinephrine, glucagon and naloxone without an IV. Now, as a PCP:

  1. Apply the six rights and handle medical orders safely
  2. Compare routes, and give drugs through the IV
  3. Calculate doses, volumes and drip rates

Textbook: Chapter 8, PDF pages 526–530 and 622–718
slides.say: Welcome back. You're not new to medications. As an EMR you already give aspirin, nitroglycerin, salbutamol and oral glucose, and epinephrine, glucagon and naloxone without an IV. What changes now? You get new drugs, a new route, the IV, and more math. An IV drug starts working in thirty to sixty seconds, so there's no time to catch a mistake. Today we'll cover three things: the six rights and handling medical orders safely; the routes, and how to give a drug through an IV line; and the dose, volume and drip-rate calculations that show up on the exam.
slides.sayZh: 欢迎回来。你对用药并不陌生。作为 EMR，你已经会给阿司匹林、硝酸甘油、沙丁胺醇、口服葡萄糖，还会在不开静脉的情况下给肾上腺素、胰高血糖素和纳洛酮。现在有什么不同？你有了新药、新途径（静脉），还有更多计算。静脉药物三十到六十秒就起效，出了错根本来不及补救。今天讲三件事：给药六个正确和怎样安全处理医嘱；各种给药途径，以及怎样经静脉管路给药；还有考试常考的剂量、体积和滴速计算。

slides.title: The six rights
slides.body:
• Right patient
  • Right medication
  • Right dose
  • Right route
  • Right time
  • Right documentation

Read the label three times: in the box, while drawing it up (show your partner), and just before you give it.
slides.say: Every drug, every time, goes through the six rights: right patient, right medication, right dose, right route, right time, and right documentation. Right patient matters most when there are several patients; check the name or the triage tag. Right medication means reading the label three times: in the box, while you draw it up and show your partner, and again just before you give it. Right time includes knowing when not to give a drug. And right documentation means recording the drug, dose, time, route, who gave it, and how the patient responded. If you didn't write it down, it didn't happen.
slides.sayZh: 每一种药、每一次给药，都要过六个正确：正确的病人、药物、剂量、途径、时间和记录。多名病人时，正确的病人最关键，要核对姓名或伤检标签。正确的药物意味着标签要读三遍：在药盒里时读一遍，抽药并给搭档看时读一遍，给药前再读一遍。正确的时间也包括知道什么时候不该给药。正确的记录是写下药名、剂量、时间、途径、谁给的药，以及病人的反应。没有记录，就等于没做。

slides.title: Orders and safety checks
slides.body:
• Standing orders = indirect medical control (written protocol)
  • Direct medical control = talk to the physician first
  • Report fully: age, weight, allergies, history, medications
  • Unclear or unusual order? Ask them to repeat it
  • Read back drug, dose and route: you share the responsibility
  • Cloudy, discoloured, cracked or expired? Don't use it
slides.say: Where do your orders come from? Standing orders are written protocols that let you act without calling anyone; that's indirect medical control. Direct medical control means you speak with a physician before you give the drug. When you call, give the full picture: age, weight, allergies, medical problems and medications. The doctor can only decide as well as you report. If an order is unclear, or the dose or route seems unusual, ask them to repeat it. Always read back the drug, the dose and the route; you're as responsible as the physician. And before giving anything, check allergies, concentration and expiry, and look for cloudiness or cracks.
slides.sayZh: 你的医嘱从哪里来？常规医嘱是书面协议，让你不用打电话就能执行，这叫间接医疗指导。直接医疗指导是指给药前先和医生通话。打电话时要报全病情：年龄、体重、过敏、疾病和用药。医生的决定只能和你的报告一样好。如果医嘱听不清，或剂量、途径看起来不寻常，请对方再说一遍。一定要复述药名、剂量和途径；你和医生负同样的责任。给任何药之前，都要查过敏、浓度和有效期，看药液是否浑浊、容器是否破裂。

slides.title: Routes: how fast do they work?
slides.body:
RouteOnset (good perfusion)
Intravenous30–60 seconds
Inhaled2–3 minutes
Intranasal, sublingual3–5 minutes
Intramuscular10–20 minutes
Subcutaneous15–30 minutes
Oral30–90 minutes

The book also lists IO and tracheal routes: not in BC EMR/PCP scope.
slides.say: The route decides how fast a drug works. These are the textbook's onset times for a healthy, well-perfused person. IV is fastest, thirty to sixty seconds, because the drug goes straight into the blood. Inhaled drugs take two to three minutes; intranasal and sublingual, meaning under the tongue, three to five. Intramuscular takes ten to twenty minutes, subcutaneous fifteen to thirty, and oral is slowest, thirty to ninety. The book also teaches the intraosseous and tracheal routes. Both are outside BC EMR and PCP scope, so never pick them on your exam.
slides.sayZh: 给药途径决定药物起效多快。这些是教材给出的、健康且灌注良好的人的起效时间。静脉最快，三十到六十秒，因为药物直接进入血液。吸入要两到三分钟；鼻内和舌下三到五分钟。肌注十到二十分钟，皮下十五到三十分钟，口服最慢，三十到九十分钟。书里还讲了骨髓腔和气管内途径，这两种都不在 BC EMR 和 PCP 的范围内，考试时千万别选。

slides.title: Injections: angle and volume
slides.body:
RouteAngleVolumeNeedle
Intradermal10–15°< 1 mL25–27 G
Subcutaneous45°≤ 1 mL24–26 G
Intramuscular90°up to 5 mL21–22 G
  • IM sites: deltoid (about 4–5 cm below the acromion), outer thigh
  • IM and subcutaneous absorption need good perfusion
  • BC epinephrine is IM only: still the route in anaphylaxis
slides.say: You already give intramuscular injections as an EMR, but you should know all three injection types. Intradermal goes just under the top layer of skin, at ten to fifteen degrees, less than one millilitre. Subcutaneous goes into the fat layer at forty-five degrees, one millilitre or less. Intramuscular goes into muscle at ninety degrees, up to five millilitres, in the deltoid about four to five centimetres below the bony tip of the shoulder, or the outer thigh. The deeper point: these routes depend on blood flow, so in profound shock absorption is slow and unreliable. That's one reason the IV matters. But in BC, epinephrine is IM only, so give it IM in anaphylaxis without delay.
slides.sayZh: 作为 EMR 你已经会肌注，但三种注射你都应该掌握。皮内注射打在表皮下方，角度十到十五度，药量少于一毫升。皮下注射打进脂肪层，四十五度，一毫升或更少。肌内注射九十度打进肌肉，最多五毫升，部位是三角肌（肩峰骨性突起下方约四到五厘米）或大腿外侧。更深一层的道理：这些途径靠血流吸收，所以重度休克时吸收又慢又不可靠，这也是静脉通路重要的原因之一。但在 BC，肾上腺素只能肌注，所以过敏性休克时照样立即肌注。

slides.q: You're a PCP. A known diabetic is unresponsive with a blood glucose of 2.4 mmol/L. Her airway is managed. What is your first-line glucose treatment?
options: Oral glucose gel between cheek and gum
D10W 10–25 g IV; glucagon only if you can't get IV access
Glucagon IM first, then try for an IV
slides.say: Let's try a PCP decision. A known diabetic is unresponsive, with a blood glucose of two point four millimoles per litre. Her airway is managed. As a PCP, what is your first-line glucose treatment? A, oral glucose gel between the cheek and gum. B, D10W, ten to twenty-five grams IV, with glucagon only if you can't get IV access. C, glucagon IM first, then try for an IV. D, D50W, twenty-five grams IV push. Tap your answer.
slides.sayZh: 来一道 PCP 决策题。一位已知的糖尿病患者没有反应，血糖二点四毫摩尔每升，气道已处理好。作为 PCP，你首选的补糖方法是什么？A，口服葡萄糖凝胶放在颊和牙龈之间。B，静脉给 D10W 十到二十五克，开不了静脉才用胰高血糖素。C，先肌注胰高血糖素，再尝试开静脉。D，静脉推注 D50W 二十五克。点选你的答案。
slides.explain: The answer is B. In the BC diabetic protocol, the PCP obtains vascular access and gives D10W, ten to twenty-five grams, which is one hundred to two hundred fifty millilitres of the ten percent solution. Glucagon is the backup if you can't get a line. A is wrong because oral glucose is only for patients alert enough to protect their airway. C is the EMR pathway, not the PCP's first choice. D comes from the textbook, but BC has no D50W; D10W is the only IV dextrose.
slides.explainZh: 答案是 B。在 BC 糖尿病急症流程里，PCP 建立静脉通路并给 D10W 十到二十五克，也就是 10% 溶液一百到二百五十毫升；开不了静脉时才用胰高血糖素作后备。A 错，因为口服葡萄糖只给神志足以保护自己气道的病人。C 是 EMR 的做法，不是 PCP 的首选。D 来自教材，但 BC 没有 D50W，D10W 是唯一的静脉葡萄糖。

slides.title: Giving a drug through the IV
slides.body:
1. Draw up the drug, plus a 20 mL saline flush
  2. Clean the injection port
  3. Pinch the tubing above the port, or the drug flows up into the bag
  4. Push at the drug's own rate
  5. Flush (20 mL, or run briefly wide open), then reset the rate

Saline lock: first draw back for blood; stop if you feel resistance or the patient has pain.
slides.say: Now the new route: giving a drug through the IV line, called an IV push or bolus. Draw up the drug, and also twenty millilitres of normal saline for a flush. Clean the injection port. Then pinch the tubing above the port. If you forget, the drug takes the easiest path and flows up into the bag instead of into the patient. Push at the rate that drug requires; some go fast, some must go slowly. Then flush with the saline, or let the line run wide open for a moment, and set the rate back. With a saline lock, a capped catheter with no fluid running, first pull back gently to see blood, and stop if you feel resistance.
slides.sayZh: 现在讲新途径：经静脉管路给药，叫静脉推注。抽好药，再抽二十毫升生理盐水用来冲管。消毒注药口。然后捏住注药口上方的管路。如果忘了，药会走阻力最小的路，流进输液袋，而不是进入病人体内。按这种药要求的速度推注，有的要快，有的必须慢。然后用盐水冲管，或让管路短暂全速滴注，再把滴速调回原来的设置。如果是盐水锁，也就是封着帽、不输液的留置针，先轻轻回抽看到回血，感到有阻力就停。

slides.title: EMR vs PCP: drugs and routes
slides.body:
All licence levels (EMR + PCP)

  • By mouth: ASA, oral glucose, acetaminophen, ibuprofen
  • Under the tongue: nitroglycerin
  • Inhaled: salbutamol, Entonox, methoxyflurane
  • IM: epinephrine, glucagon, naloxone
  • Intranasal: glucagon, naloxone

PCP adds

  • The IV route: every IV drug is PCP work
  • D10W IV for confirmed hypoglycemia
  • IV naloxone if still unconscious and apneic
  • TXA 2 g IV over 1 minute
  • Dimenhydrinate, diphenhydramine, ondansetron
  • Ipratropium (with salbutamol), dexamethasone
slides.say: Here's the big picture of drugs and routes in BC. On the left is what every licence level gives: aspirin, oral glucose, acetaminophen and ibuprofen by mouth; nitroglycerin under the tongue; salbutamol, Entonox and methoxyflurane by inhalation; epinephrine, glucagon and naloxone by intramuscular injection, with glucagon and naloxone also into the nose. On the right is what the PCP adds. First, the IV route itself. EMRs have no IV access, so every IV drug is PCP work: D10W, IV naloxone, and TXA, or tranexamic acid. You also add new drugs: dimenhydrinate, diphenhydramine and ondansetron for nausea and allergy, and ipratropium and dexamethasone for breathing problems.
slides.sayZh: 这是 BC 药物和给药途径的全貌。左栏是所有级别都能给的：口服的阿司匹林、口服葡萄糖、对乙酰氨基酚和布洛芬；舌下的硝酸甘油；吸入的沙丁胺醇、笑气和甲氧氟烷；肌注的肾上腺素、胰高血糖素和纳洛酮，其中胰高血糖素和纳洛酮也可经鼻给。右栏是 PCP 增加的。首先是静脉途径本身。EMR 没有静脉通路权限，所以所有静脉用药都是 PCP 的工作：D10W、静脉纳洛酮，以及 TXA（氨甲环酸）。你还多了新药：治恶心和过敏的茶苯海明、苯海拉明、昂丹司琼，以及治呼吸问题的异丙托溴铵和地塞米松。

slides.title: Dose math 1: units and weight
slides.body:
• 1 g = 1,000 mg; 1 mg = 1,000 mcg; 1 L = 1,000 mL
  • Big unit → small unit: × 1,000; small → big: ÷ 1,000
  • Pounds to kilograms: ÷ 2.2 (150 lb ≈ 68 kg)
  • Quick estimate: halve it, minus 10% (close, not exact)
  • Write 0.2 mg, never .2 mg; write 2 mg, never 2.0 mg
slides.say: Dose math starts with units. In the metric system, each step here is a thousand: one gram is a thousand milligrams, one milligram is a thousand micrograms, and one litre is a thousand millilitres. From a big unit to a small one, multiply by a thousand; from small to big, divide. Weight-based doses use kilograms, so divide pounds by two point two. A one-hundred-fifty-pound patient is about sixty-eight kilograms. A quick shortcut is to halve the pounds and subtract ten percent; it's close, not exact. One safety habit: always put a zero before a decimal point, and never add a trailing zero. A misread decimal can mean a tenfold error.
slides.sayZh: 剂量计算从单位开始。在公制里，这里每一级都是一千：一克等于一千毫克，一毫克等于一千微克，一升等于一千毫升。大单位换小单位乘以一千；小单位换大单位除以一千。按体重给药要用千克，所以磅数除以二点二。一百五十磅的病人大约六十八千克。速算法是磅数减半再减去百分之十，接近但不精确。一个安全习惯：小数点前一定写零，小数末尾绝不加零。看错一个小数点，就可能差十倍。

slides.title: Dose math 2: how many mL?
slides.body:
Volume = dose wanted ÷ concentration

  • Concentration = total drug ÷ total volume
  • Percent = grams per 100 mL (10% = 10 g in 100 mL)
OrderOn handGive
Naloxone 0.4 mg2 mg in 2 mL0.4 mL
D10W 25 g10 g per 100 mL250 mL
Bolus 20 mL/kg, 70 kgnormal saline1,400 mL
slides.say: Now, how many millilitres do you give? Volume equals the dose you want divided by the concentration you have. Concentration is the total drug divided by the total volume. Say naloxone comes as two milligrams in two millilitres; that's one milligram per millilitre, so the BC first dose of zero point four milligrams is zero point four millilitres. A percentage means grams per hundred millilitres, so D10W, ten percent, has ten grams in every hundred millilitres. Twenty-five grams is two hundred fifty millilitres, matching the BC protocol. And a twenty-millilitre-per-kilogram bolus for a seventy-kilogram patient is fourteen hundred millilitres.
slides.sayZh: 那么要给多少毫升？体积等于所需剂量除以手上的浓度。浓度等于药物总量除以总体积。比如纳洛酮是两毫克装在两毫升里，也就是每毫升一毫克，所以 BC 的首剂零点四毫克就是零点四毫升。百分比的意思是每一百毫升含多少克，所以 D10W（10%）每一百毫升含十克。二十五克就是二百五十毫升，和 BC 流程一致。按每公斤二十毫升推注，七十公斤的病人就是一千四百毫升。

slides.q: A hypotensive trauma patient weighs about 220 lb. Using the BC hypovolemia protocol, how much fluid can you give, and how?
slides.say: Quiz time, with a calculation. A hypotensive trauma patient weighs about two hundred twenty pounds. Using the BC hypovolemia protocol, how much fluid can you give, and how? A, one thousand millilitres, reassessing at the end. B, two thousand millilitres, reassessing every five hundred. C, four thousand four hundred millilitres, reassessing every litre. D, two thousand two hundred millilitres, reassessing every five hundred. Tap your answer.
slides.sayZh: 测验时间，来道计算题。一位低血压的创伤病人体重约二百二十磅。按 BC 低血容量流程，你最多能给多少液体、怎么给？A，一千毫升，输完再复评。B，两千毫升，每五百毫升复评一次。C，四千四百毫升，每一升复评一次。D，两千二百毫升，每五百毫升复评一次。点选你的答案。
slides.explain: The answer is B. Two hundred twenty pounds divided by two point two is one hundred kilograms. Twenty millilitres per kilogram gives two thousand millilitres, exactly the BC maximum of two litres, and you reassess every five hundred. C multiplied by pounds instead of kilograms. D used a rough weight and ignored the two-litre cap. A is too little and waits too long to reassess.
slides.explainZh: 答案是 B。二百二十磅除以二点二等于一百千克，每公斤二十毫升就是两千毫升，正好是 BC 的上限两升，并且每五百毫升复评一次。C 用磅数而不是千克去乘了。D 用了粗略体重，还忽略了两升上限。A 量太少，而且复评太晚。

slides.title: Drip rates
slides.body:
gtt/min = mL × drop factor ÷ minutes

  • BC example: 500 mL over 12 h, 10 gtt/mL → 5,000 ÷ 720 ≈ 7 gtt/min
  • From mL/h: ÷ 6 (10-drop), ÷ 4 (15-drop), same number (60-drop)
  • BC maintenance ≈ 75 mL/h → about 12–13 gtt/min on a 10-drop set
  • BC IV acetaminophen: 100 mL over 15 min, 10-drop set → 66 gtt/min
slides.say: Drip rate means drops per minute. The formula: millilitres to give, times the drop factor of your set, divided by the minutes. Here's BC's own example: five hundred millilitres over twelve hours with a ten-drop set. Five hundred times ten is five thousand; twelve hours is seven hundred twenty minutes; so about seven drops a minute. If the order is in millilitres per hour, use the shortcut: divide by six for a ten-drop set, by four for a fifteen-drop set, and with a sixty-drop set the number stays the same. BC's maintenance rate is about seventy-five millilitres an hour, so roughly twelve or thirteen drops a minute on a ten-drop set.
slides.sayZh: 滴速就是每分钟多少滴。公式是：要输的毫升数，乘以输液器的滴系数，再除以分钟数。看 BC 自己的例子：十二小时输五百毫升，用十滴输液器。五百乘十是五千；十二小时是七百二十分钟；所以大约每分钟七滴。如果医嘱是每小时多少毫升，用速算法：十滴输液器除以六，十五滴的除以四，六十滴的数字不变。BC 的维持速度大约每小时七十五毫升，用十滴输液器就是每分钟十二到十三滴左右。

slides.title: For the BC exam
slides.body:
• Book uses D50W; BC IV dextrose is D10W only (10–25 g = 100–250 mL)
  • Tracheal (LEAN) and IO routes: not in BC EMR/PCP scope
  • Epinephrine: IM only in BC, no IV push
  • Diazepam, atropine, lidocaine, dopamine: not BC EMR/PCP drugs
  • Naloxone: 0.4 → 0.4 → 0.8 → 2.0 mg IM/IV q3 min, or 4 mg IN
slides.say: Here's where the textbook and BC differ. The book's examples use D50W, fifty percent dextrose. In BC the only IV dextrose is D10W, ten to twenty-five grams. The book teaches tracheal drugs, remembered as LEAN, and the IO route; neither is in BC EMR or PCP scope. Epinephrine in BC is intramuscular only; there's no IV epinephrine for you. The book's practice problems use diazepam, atropine, lidocaine and dopamine. Learn the math, but those drugs aren't on the BC EMR or PCP list. And BC naloxone is zero point four, zero point four, zero point eight, then two milligrams, IM or IV, every three minutes, or four milligrams intranasal, after you secure ventilation.
slides.sayZh: 这里是教材和 BC 不同的地方。书里的例子用 D50W（50% 葡萄糖）；BC 唯一的静脉葡萄糖是 D10W，十到二十五克。书里讲气管内给药（口诀 LEAN）和 IO 途径，两者都不在 BC EMR 和 PCP 范围内。BC 的肾上腺素只能肌注，你没有静脉肾上腺素。书里的练习题用了地西泮、阿托品、利多卡因和多巴胺。计算方法要学会，但这些药不在 BC EMR 或 PCP 药物范围内。BC 的纳洛酮是零点四、零点四、零点八，然后两毫克，肌注或静脉，每三分钟评估一次；或者经鼻四毫克，而且要先保证通气。

slides.title: New for you as a PCP: watch out for
slides.body:
• IV drugs act in seconds: recheck the math before you push
  • Push rate matters: TXA 2 g over 1 minute; faster can drop the BP
  • Dimenhydrinate IV: dilute with saline, push slowly over 1–2 min
  • D10W leaking into tissue can cause necrosis: confirm the line first
  • Pinch above the port, then flush, so the full dose arrives
  • Cloudy tubing after mixing drugs? Clamp it and replace the set
slides.say: Now the new risks. An IV drug acts within seconds, so there's no time to fix an error once it's in. Recheck your calculation and read the label again. Push rate matters as much as dose. BC's TXA dose is two grams pushed over one minute; pushing faster can drop the blood pressure. Dimenhydrinate given IV must be diluted with normal saline and pushed slowly, over one to two minutes. D10W can badly damage tissue if it leaks out of the vein, so confirm the line is working before and during the dose. Pinch the tubing, then flush. And if the tubing turns cloudy after you mix drugs, clamp it right away and change the set.
slides.sayZh: 现在讲新的风险。静脉药物几秒钟就起效，一旦推进去，出错就来不及补救。推之前再算一遍、再读一遍标签。推注速度和剂量一样重要。BC 的 TXA 剂量是两克、一分钟推完，推得更快会让血压下降。茶苯海明静脉给药必须用生理盐水稀释，一到两分钟慢慢推。D10W 如果漏出静脉会严重损伤组织，所以给药前和给药中都要确认通路通畅。先捏住管路，推完再冲管。如果混合用药后管路变浑浊，立刻夹闭并更换输液器。

slides.title: Three things to remember
slides.body:
1. Six rights, label three times, read back every verbal order
  2. The IV route is PCP-only and fastest: right push rate, then flush
  3. Volume = dose ÷ concentration; gtt/min = mL × drop factor ÷ minutes

Next: Chapter 9, Human Development
slides.say: Let's wrap up with three things to remember. One: every drug goes through the six rights. Read the label three times, and read back every verbal order: drug, dose and route. Two: the IV route is new for you as a PCP, and it's the fastest, so give each drug at its correct rate and flush it through. Remember the BC differences: D10W, not D50W; epinephrine IM only; no IO or tracheal drugs. Three: the math. Volume equals dose divided by concentration, and drops per minute equal millilitres times drop factor, divided by minutes. Next class, we start Chapter nine, human development. If anything was unclear, tap Ask. See you next class.
slides.sayZh: 收尾三句话。一，每一种药都要过六个正确：标签读三遍，每条口头医嘱都要复述药名、剂量和途径。二，静脉途径是你作为 PCP 新获得的，也是最快的，所以每种药都要按正确速度推注，并冲管送进去。记住 BC 的不同：用 D10W 不用 D50W；肾上腺素只能肌注；没有 IO 和气管内给药。三，计算：体积等于剂量除以浓度；每分钟滴数等于毫升数乘滴系数再除以分钟数。下节课开始第 9 章，人类发展。有不懂的点「Ask」。下节课见。
